purpose: The HN discussion backfill recovers exactly the stories the reader already sees as title-only, without analysing a year of never-shown items into the unread list.
form: get_unreadable_content (storage.py) gains a title_only_flagged keyword, default False; when True its paging query adds AND json_extract(c.analysis, '$.title_only') = 1, so only flagged rows are paged and the readability filter and limit apply to them as today. run_refetch (refetch.py) takes the same keyword and passes it through, and the refetch command (__main__.py) exposes it as --title-only, so a dry run reports the narrowed count and cost estimate.
commitments: With --title-only, refetch selects only non-archived, unreadable rows of the given type whose analysis records title_only = true, oldest first, up to --limit; rows with title_only false or no title_only key are never selected.
Without --title-only, the selection is exactly what it is today, rows with no title_only key included.
refetch --dry-run --title-only reports the narrowed selection's count and cost estimate.
On <host> after deploy, refetch --type rss --title-only --dry-run selects the 39 flagged HN items, and the real run reports how many were recovered from their discussion.
sacrifices: The 1,304 unflagged HN rows that were never analysed, and the 4 with title_only false, stay as they are.
risk: A JSON boolean stored as true must match json_extract(...) = 1; a test with a real database stores a flagged row through the normal analysis path and asserts it is selected.
